scope: Targeted semantic and formula-syntax audit; no full numeric regression or kernel compilation.
sigma1_verdict: Both CHECK formulas are leading existential blocks followed by bounded formulas over Nat addition, multiplication, order, and equality after capture-avoiding macro expansion.
exact_checker_verdict: The dense and sparse graphs express exactly check(c,n)=true. Descending Cantor children align the row recursion with decodeFuel(c+1)c; invalid parsing or invalid proof validity both store0, while a valid conclusion n stores n+1.
W_verdict: No obstruction. W must dominate decoded fields, all stored values, and all circuit/intermediate comparison outputs including a prospective wim value in a failing MP branch. Such a finite global W exists. Beta quotient bounds are B and do not need to be <=W.
sortedness_verdict: No bounded-h loophole: every earlier index already has a unique beta key <=W by its row obligation, so FORALL h<=W sees that actual key. LOOKUP only uses smaller indices; missing children cannot masquerade as invalid0.
required_textual_clarifications: State that every macro expansion alpha-renames bound variables to avoid capture.
Define rejection by replacing the final BETA(Bv,Cv,last,n+1) with EXISTS r<=W (BETA(Bv,Cv,last,r) AND r!=n+1), retaining the other history conditions; do not merely append an unbound v!=n+1.
limitations: No claim that a new PA or Lean proof has been kernel checked.
The targeted symbolic constructor equality is exact for the exported definitions; their identification with the Lean source was reviewed manually and its source hash checked.
No large bundle regression or full72-code suite was rerun.

presentation_followup.status: Both requested clarifications implemented and independently reviewed
presentation_followup.capture_avoidance: Explicit alpha-renaming instruction added to finite macro expansion
presentation_followup.rejection: Complete REJECT_SPARSE has its own final value r, r<=W, and r!=n+1; final acceptance equality is absent
presentation_followup.rejection_complement: Follows from total existence and uniqueness of row evaluation; no n+1<=W bound is required in rejection
